rulings.model: The IRS line is the number of qualifying children "x $1,700", using the same count as line 4. The restatement adds up dependent.actc_amount, which is not defined, so I can't confirm it is $1,700 for each child counted on line 4.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The count and the dollar lines are sums over the listed persons of a per-person amount ($2,200, $500 or $1,700 for a person who qualifies, else zero), defined on the dependent worksheet, which has its own transcription, render and class M logs; the per-person predicates are Steps 3 and 5 of the Form 1040 instructions. The count times the dollar figure and the sum of the per-person figures are the same number. No change to the data.

rulings.restated: Subtract f8959 line 22 from helper "Additional Medicare Tax and RRTA Tax Worksheet, line 4. Add social security tax withheld, Medicare tax withheld (Form 8959, line 19) and Form 8959, line 7".
rulings.model: The restatement stops at worksheet line 6 (lines 1+2+3 minus Form 8959 line 22), but the IRS says line 21 is "Add lines 6, 7, 11, and 15. Enter here and on line 21 of Schedule 8812". It leaves out the Tier 1 RRTA amounts (lines 11 and 15) and half of the Additional Medicare Tax on self-employment income (line 7), and line 21 has no refusal naming those cases.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. The Tier 1 RRTA amounts on lines 11 and 15 of the Additional Medicare Tax and RRTA Tax Worksheet are outside the slice: `person.rrta` refuses the per-person Medicare totals that Form 8959 line 19 sums, and this line reads that total, so a return with RRTA compensation refuses here. No change to the data.
